title: PrismML, which says its 1-bit LLM achieves radical compression without sacrificing performance, comes out of stealth with $16.25M in SAFE and seed funding (Steven Rosenbush/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Steven Rosenbush / Wall Street Journal: PrismML, which says its 1-bit LLM achieves radical compression without sacrificing performance, comes out of stealth with $16.25M in SAFE and seed funding — PrismML says its 1-bit large language model achieves radical compression without sacrificing performance, lowering energy consumption
